ble_219_0c06c2e0.name: hci_transport_h4_rx_advance
ble_219_0c06c2e0.summary: Advance the H4 UART receive state machine by the bytes just received
ble_219_0c06c2e0.description: Called after each receive chunk: the count requested last time (DAT_20019328) is added to the buffer offset DAT_20019448, then state DAT_2001932A selects the next step. State 0 (idle) stops; state 1 reads the H4 packet-type byte at DAT_20019334 and moves to state 2 for event (type 4, 2-byte header), state 3 for ACL (type 2, 4-byte header, u16 length at offset 3, at most 255 bytes) or state 4 for SCO (type 3, 3-byte header, length byte at offset 3); any other type is logged as invalid. State 6 hands the complete packet (type, payload, length) to the upper-layer callback at DAT_2000499C and returns to state 1 expecting one type byte. Each step asks the UART driver (ops table DAT_20019324, slot +0x20) to receive the next N bytes at buffer+offset; errors are logged through ble_hook_invoke_indexed channel 2.
ble_219_0c06c2e0.notes: State 5 (ISO header, 14-bit length with bits 8..13 required to be zero) is implemented, but no transition into it appears in this function, since types other than 2, 3 and 4 are rejected. The UART ops table and the upper callback are globals with no names yet. Callers: none direct (invoked from the UART receive path).

ble_219_0c06fb92.name: __aeabi_ddiv_special_case

ble_219_0c06fe20.name: __divdi3
ble_219_0c06fe20.summary: Signed 64-bit division (__divdi3) with saturation on a zero divisor
ble_219_0c06fe20.description: Divides the signed 64-bit dividend (param_1, param_2) by (param_3, param_4). A zero divisor returns INT64_MIN for a negative dividend, INT64_MAX for a positive non-zero dividend, and 0 for zero. Otherwise it divides the absolute values with __udivmoddi4 (0x0C06FEF0), keeps the remainder in a local, and negates the quotient when exactly one operand is negative. ble_219_0c0701e0.name: atol
ble_219_0c0701e0.summary: Parse a base-10 integer from a string, saturating and setting ERANGE on overflow
ble_219_0c0701e0.description: Skips leading whitespace (ctype bit 0x08 at 0x0C0862A9), accepts one optional '+' or '-', and reads decimal digits; a letter ends the number because only base 10 is accepted. Accumulation saturates at 0x7FFFFFFF (or 0x80000000 for a negative value), and on overflow it stores ERANGE (34) through the errno pointer at DAT_200049A8. ble_219_0c0701e0.notes: Single-argument form, so atol or atoi; both are the same on this target. Callers 0c04855c, 0c055634, 0c05569c, 0c055b90.

ble_219_0c070a1c.name: libc_tm_normalize
ble_219_0c070a1c.summary: Normalise a struct tm in place, carrying or borrowing from seconds up to years
ble_219_0c070a1c.description: Operates on six 32-bit fields (sec, min, hour, mday, mon, year, with year counted from 1900). Out-of-range values are carried into the next field using div by 60, 60, 24 and 12, month lengths from the table at 0x0C0745FC, and the Gregorian leap-year rule for February. param_2 is a signed flag: when it is negative the remainder is rebased by adding the divisor and the quotient is decremented by one, which handles borrowing from negative differences.
